Implementation approach: We will implement a Laravel 10+ API system for Volopa OOP Expenses using a modular architecture with three core modules: User Management & Permissions (RBAC with delegation), CSV Batch Upload (sync validation + async processing), and Single Expense CRUD (with FX conversion). The system follows Laravel best practices with thin controllers, service-layer business logic, Form Request validation, API Resources for response shaping, and Eloquent models with explicit relationships. We'll use existing Volopa infrastructure (OAuth2 middleware, queue system, file storage) and integrate with platform tables (users, clients, transaction_category). The architecture supports multi-tenancy via client_id scoping, implements soft delete patterns, and uses background jobs for CSV processing. Key open-source libraries include Laravel's built-in Queue system for async processing, Eloquent ORM for database operations, and Laravel's validation system for comprehensive input validation.

Program call flow:
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Client
    participant MW as Oauth2UserClient
    participant UPC as UserFeaturePermissionController
    participant UPS as UserPermissionService
    participant UFP as UserFeaturePermission
    participant PEC as PocketExpenseController
    participant PES as PocketExpenseService
    participant FXS as PocketExpenseFXService
    participant PE as PocketExpense
    participant PEUC as PocketExpenseUploadController
    participant CSV as PocketExpenseCSVValidator
    participant PEFU as PocketExpenseFileUpload
    participant Q as Queue
    participant PEU as ProcessExpenseUpload
    
    Note over C,PEU: User Permission Management Flow
    C->>MW: POST /api/v1/user-feature-permissions
    MW->>UPC: grantPermission(request)
    UPC->>UPS: grantPermission(userId, clientId, featureId, grantorId, managerId)
    UPS->>UFP: create(permissionData)
    UFP-->>UPS: UserFeaturePermission instance
    UPS-->>UPC: UserFeaturePermission
    UPC-->>MW: 201 UserFeaturePermissionResource
    MW-->>C: 201 success response
    
    Note over C,PEU: Single Expense CRUD with FX Conversion Flow
    C->>MW: POST /api/v1/pocket-expenses
    MW->>PEC: store(StorePocketExpenseRequest)
    PEC->>PES: create(validatedData)
    PES->>FXS: convertExpenseAmount(expenseData)
    FXS->>FXS: getWalletBaseCurrency(clientId)
    FXS->>FXS: getFXRate(fromCurrency, toCurrency, date)
    FXS->>FXS: calculateConversion(amount, rate, commission)
    FXS-->>PES: conversionResult
    PES->>PE: create(expenseWithFXData)
    PE-->>PES: PocketExpense instance
    PES-->>PEC: PocketExpense
    PEC-->>MW: 201 PocketExpenseResource
    MW-->>C: 201 expense created
    
    C->>MW: PUT /api/v1/pocket-expenses/{id}
    MW->>PEC: update(UpdatePocketExpenseRequest, id)
    PEC->>PES: update(id, validatedData)
    PES->>PE: find(id)
    PE-->>PES: existing PocketExpense
    PES->>FXS: convertExpenseAmount(updatedData)
    FXS-->>PES: newConversionResult
    PES->>PE: update(updatedExpenseWithFX)
    PE-->>PES: updated PocketExpense
    PES-->>PEC: PocketExpense
    PEC-->>MW: 200 PocketExpenseResource
    MW-->>C: 200 expense updated
    
    Note over C,PEU: CSV Batch Upload Processing Flow
    C->>MW: POST /api/uploads/pocket-expense/csv
    MW->>PEUC: uploadPocketExpenseCSV(UploadPocketExpenseCSVRequest)
    PEUC->>PEFU: create(uploadRecord with status='uploaded')
    PEFU-->>PEUC: PocketExpenseFileUpload instance
    PEUC->>CSV: validate(csvFile, targetUserId, clientId, adminId)
    CSV->>CSV: preloadReferenceData(clientId)
    CSV->>CSV: validateHeaders(csvHeaders)
    loop For each CSV row
        CSV->>CSV: validateRow(rowData, lineNumber)
    end
    CSV-->>PEUC: validationResult
    PEUC->>PEFU: update(totalRecords, validRecords, errors, status)
    PEFU-->>PEUC: updated upload record
    
    alt Validation Failed
        PEUC-->>MW: 422 validation errors
        MW-->>C: 422 structured error response
    else Validation Passed
        PEUC->>PEFU: bulkInsert to pocket_expense_uploads_data
        PEUC->>PEFU: update(status='processing')
        PEUC->>Q: dispatch ProcessExpenseUpload(uploadId)
        Q-->>PEUC: job queued
        PEUC-->>MW: 200 success with uploadId
        MW-->>C: 200 upload queued for processing
        
        Note over Q,PEU: Background Processing
        Q->>PEU: handle()
        PEU->>PEU: syncExpensesToMainService(validatedRows)
        loop Batch of 100 rows
            PEU->>PES: create(batchExpenseData)
            PES->>PE: bulkCreate(expenses)
            PE-->>PES: created expenses
            PES-->>PEU: batch success
        end
        PEU->>PEFU: update(status='completed', processed_at)
        PEU->>PEU: notifyUser()
    end
System constraints: Maximum 200 rows per CSV file upload
CSV file format must be CSV or TXT with CSV content
Maximum file size 10MB (10240 KB) for CSV uploads
Header row mandatory in CSV and must exactly match required column names
All-or-nothing validation: if any CSV row fails validation, no expenses are created
Date must not be older than 3 years from current date
Date format must be DD/MM/YYYY (DD-MM-YYYY in template)
Currency Code must be 3-letter ISO format and in platform allowed list
Amount sign determined by expense type: Refund = positive, others = negative
VAT % must be numeric between 0-100 (strip % sign)
Source must match configured sources for client including global Other
Source Note required when Source = Other
Merchant Name maximum length per DB definition VARCHAR(180)
Only Primary Admin has full access to all users by default
Admin gets full access only to own expenses by default; needs explicit grant for others
Business User and Card User cannot approve expenses even with management rights
Managing access can be given to any user irrespective of role
Admin can only grant access to their own managed users not all users
Maximum 20 active expense sources per client
Unique source names per client (client_id, name constraint)
Global Other record (client_id = NULL) is not deletable or editable
Soft-deleted sources excluded from future dropdowns but visible on historical records
3 default sources auto-created on feature enable: Cash, Corporate Card, Personal Card
FX rate lookup maximum 30-day lookback from expense date
If no FX rate found, return No FX Available
Backend must recalculate FX on save do not trust frontend-only value
Commission formula: AdjustedRate = BaseRate x (1 - Comm%)
All queries and mutations must be scoped by client_id for multi-tenancy
user_id must match authenticated user server-side check
Target entities expense_user_id must belong to the same client_id
All new tables must use InnoDB engine with utf8mb4 character set and utf8mb4_unicode_ci collation
